**TotalEnergies Lubricants** is a world leader in the production and distribution of **lubricants for consumers, industry, agriculture and transportation professionals.** The company has 41 production sites throughout the world and employs more than 5,800 people in 150 countries.

## A Graphic Design Project.

Since 2021, I have been working with TotalEnergies Lubricants teams to create & develop graphic guidelines, information documents, packshots and labels.

<Image
  alt={`From WordPress to Nextjs`}
  src={`/static/images/projects/ELF-BROCHURE.png`}
  width={1080 / 2}
  height={1080 / 2}
  priority
/>

## Achievements:

To meet the client's expectations, I worked in a **collaborative way** using Microsoft Teams, SharePoint & Adobe Creative Cloud. This work method allowed me to be as **efficient and agile as possible** in order to provide the highest level of satisfaction. I was able to stand out in the speed of execution of the deliverables ordered by the client.
